Other A locations: upper is green circle (green ≈1.0, circle 1.0) but currently unattended;
If you command attention to a direction in view A, the model predicts nearly certain selection of that corresponding location (upper/right/lower/left each ~0.997–0.999).

View B: attention is almost entirely on the upper location (selection probability 0.99873). That upper item is mostly red and most likely triangular (red ≈0.99948; triangle ≈0.99992). Its recoverability is 0.20881 now, 0.15624 after one step, 0.11509 after two steps.
Other B locations: right is yellow cross;
Directional commands in view B are predicted to shift selection reliably to the corresponding location (upper/right/lower/left each ~0.999).
